dashboard.label: Better Map - Debug HUD
dashboard.description: Internal state HUD overlay - shows MapLibre's resolved style, lifecycle events, source/layer counts, and any errors. Use to diagnose why a basemap fails to render. Two panels: openfreemap-liberty (vector) and osm_raster (inline raster). Compare the HUD output side-by-side against the standalone Phase 2 maps in network_diagnostic.html.
